name: Corporate Minimal
description: Clean, professional corporate aesthetic with minimal design

color_palette.description: Cool blues and grays, high contrast, professional

visual_style.detail_level: medium - focus on key elements only
visual_style.composition: centered, balanced, lots of negative space

donts: No overly artistic or abstract imagery
prompt_template: Create a {subject} in a corporate minimal style. Use a color palette of cool blues (#3498DB, #2980B9) and grays (#2C3E50, #7F8C8D) with clean white backgrounds. Design should be flat with subtle shadows, smooth textures, and medium detail level focusing on key elements only. Composition should be centered and balanced with lots of negative space. Style: professional, trustworthy, modern. Include clean geometric shapes, high contrast, grid-based layout. DO: use simple geometric icons, consistent line weights, subtle gradients. DON'T: include cluttered elements, bright neon colors, hand-drawn elements, or decorative patterns.
